claims.text: The span detector architecture includes a shared lower layer and separate top layers for the span detector and binary classifier tasks.
The shared layer consists of a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer, and a memory generation layer.
The model employs a bilinear function to determine the start and end points of answer spans.
The architecture is based on the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) and includes a multi-turn answer module.
